scenes: Tergrid, Iron Fortress. What your opponents sacrifice or discard becomes yours.
Make them sacrifice. Sheoldred's Edict, in its nontoken mode: each opponent sacrifices a nontoken creature.
Fast mana, with every card under a hundred dollars. Sol Ring, Mana Vault, Lotus Petal, Dark Ritual and Cabal Ritual start fast. Basalt Monolith and Mind Stone keep the mana coming.
